sar.narrative: Customer C10751, holder of card C10751-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-24 17:00 and 2016-11-24 17:21, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.11 were made on the card online from device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 63.0 | ': $464.46 (3483817, 2016-11-24 17:00), $488.58 (3483854, 2016-11-24 17:10), $477.85 (3483876, 2016-11-24 17:16), $475.22 (3483895, 2016-11-24 17:21). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 21 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($464.46, $488.58, $477.85, $475.22; total $1,906.11). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
